messages:
Priya: Heads-up - we started seeing ~25% GPU warmup failures in eu-central-1 at 01:10 UTC. Pattern looks like KMS decrypt latency/timeouts, not disk I/O.
Chen: Which KMS path? regional HSM or central keystore?
Priya: HSM-backed KMS in eu-central-1 (hsm1) started queueing. Multiple ephemeral-keystore Decrypts hit 500-1200ms, then timeouts. Example logs: 
```
2026-03-23T01:11:05Z keystore: Decrypt latency 1187ms for host gpu-eu-11
2026-03-23T01:11:07Z keystore: Decrypt timeout for gpu-eu-12 -> fallback to penaltybox
```
Luca: Penaltybox engaged means hosts can't fetch ephemeral keys -> disk remains encrypted -> join fail. Is this caused by recent IAM tighter-scope change?
Priya: We rolled the IAM conditional policy yesterday (restrict keystore:Decrypt to source VPC subnets). Seems fine, but HSM node count dropped (autoscaler bug) and combined with audit-shipper backfill we saturated HSM queue.
Omar: Quick mitigations? Options: 1) bump HSM replicas in eu-central-1 (fast but needs team approval) 2) temporarily relax IAM condition to allow keystore calls from warmup-subnet range 3) failover warmup traffic to keystore-eu-secondary (cross-az, pre-authorized) 4) open VPC endpoint to KMS to avoid NAT egress & reduce latency.
Chen: Cost and risk? Bumping HSM = infra ops time + ~$4k/day if we leave extra nodes. Relax IAM condition = low cost, higher blast radius. Cross-region failover = possible but needs KMS grants for cross-account/grants; adds latency. VPC endpoint -> modest hourly + data processing charges but immediate latency win and no NAT.
Priya: I can open a scoped whitelist in IAM for the warmup subnet for 1 hour. Quick PR and rollback. Prefer minimal blast radius.
Luca: Approve scoped whitelist. Also do a short canary: enable whitelist for 10% of warmup hosts, monitor decrypt latency and join success.
Infra-bot: iam-policy-change proposed by Priya at 01:23 UTC: add allow keystore:Decrypt for principal "warmup-subnets" for 1 hour.
Priya: Canary started at 01:27 UTC for 10% hosts. Early metrics: decrypt latency back under 200ms for canary hosts, join success recovered.
Omar: Follow-ups: 1) create ENGINFRA-9001 to fix keystore autoscaler bug 2) assess adding KMS VPC endpoint in eu-central-1 (ticket ENGINFRA-9002) 3) add metric keystore.hsm.queue_depth and alert at 50% capacity.
Chen: Estimate cost: KMS endpoint via PrivateLink + data processing ~ $0.40/hr + variable data cost; lifting HSM replicas temporarily ~ $3.5k/day. Whitelist approach cost negligible. We'll charge to incident ops.
Luca: Longer term: 1) pre-warm HSM capacity windows for known backfills 2) avoid evicting warmup hosts on keystore timeouts (treat as degraded) 3) add graceful fallback to local encrypted cache if decrypt fails for <60s.
Priya: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/iam/pull/780 (whitelist warmup-subnet) - merging after one more review.
Omar: I'll take ENGINFRA-9001 and -9002. Priya, add runbook steps under "kek/hsm saturation" for whitelist/canary and VPC endpoint flip.
Priya: Marking resolved pending PR merge and 12h stable metrics. Thanks team :thumbsup:
